s: Raw iid Gaussian phase variance at q=pi/3.
strict_positivity: D4(s)>0 for every finite s>0; each factor is positive.
TV_bound_scope: Lower bound on latent intensity-law TV, not the TV itself.
maximizer_scope: Unique maximum of D4 and the degree<=4 bounded-polynomial witness gap. No optimization of full TV, detector TV, Fisher information, or experimental design.

panel_B.horizontal_variable: r=s/s_ref in [0.1,1]; s_ref is a conceptual small-noise reference.
panel_B.normalization: Each power separately equals 1 at r=1; unknown prefactors are suppressed.
panel_B.meaning: Illustration of the sharp asymptotic powers only, not exact ratios m(s)/m(s_ref).
panel_B.Gaussian: sigma>0 fixed, independent additive N(0,sigma^2) readout noise; Theta(s^-10).
panel_B.positive_background_Poisson: b>0, eta>0 fixed, N|I~Poisson(b+eta I); Theta(s^-10).
panel_B.zero_background_Poisson: b=0, eta>0 fixed, full count retained; Theta(s^-6).
panel_B.conditions: Any fixed target success a in (1/2,1), equal priors, independent observations, known competing models, fixed calibrated detector parameters as s tends to zero.
panel_B.limitations: Exact finite-noise sample counts, the optimal sample-count prefactor, joint detector-parameter limits, experimental independence, or calibrated physical performance.
